title: Understanding EMI on a business loan
summary: What an EMI is and how the rate and months change it.

sections.heading: What is an EMI?
paragraphs: EMI means equated monthly instalment. It is the fixed amount you pay each month to repay a loan with interest.

sections.heading: How the rate and months change it
paragraphs: A higher rate or a longer loan changes what you pay each month and in total. Try different numbers in the EMI calculator.

sections.heading: Check before you borrow
paragraphs: Ask the lender for the total amount you will pay, with all charges. Your lender's figure may differ a little from a calculator.
